title: Karen Silkwood and the missing plutonium
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Karen Silkwood and the missing plutonium, about 1974 at Nuclear reprocessing plant, Oklahoma, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: that she discovered that they were missing 40 lbs of uh 98% bomb G plutonium from this facility

plain: Dan Sheehan, who says he was involved in the case, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about Karen Silkwood, a worker at a nuclear fuel plant in Oklahoma in 1974. According to Sheehan, she discovered that about 40 pounds of plutonium pure enough for bombs had gone missing from the facility. If true, it would mean bomb material vanished from an American plant and someone wanted that kept quiet.
